title: Fuzz-Policy Enforcement Infrastructure

parser_inventory.description: Authoritative registry of 48 parser surfaces with trust boundary classification, source file mapping, and fuzz status tracking

corpus_manifest.description: Corpus/seed metadata schema with bounded resource budgets (4 tiers: small/medium/large/network), staleness enforcement (90-day threshold)

ci_gate.description: Fail-closed CI validation: duplicate IDs, path traversal, missing tickets, source existence, trust boundary warnings, unclassified parser detection

mutation_tests.description: 54 tests covering omissions, path traversal, duplicate IDs, stale corpora, missing blockers, resource budget violations, trust boundary warnings, manifest consistency

wiki_doc.description: Security documentation: parser trust model, fuzz policy rules, risk-priority matrix, onboarding guide for new parsers

authoritative_parser_inventory.evidence: 48 parsers classified across 3 trust boundaries with source file references

corpus_seed_metadata_and_budgets.evidence: Schema defined with 4 resource tiers, staleness enforcement, per-target budget validation

fail_closed_ci_gate.evidence: check_fuzz_policy.py validates classification completeness, source existence, path traversal, duplicate IDs; --ci mode treats unclassified as hard failures

mutation_tests.evidence: 54 tests across 12 classes, all passing, covering omissions/traversal/duplicates/staleness/budget violations

security_docs.evidence: wiki/advanced/Fuzz-Policy-and-Parser-Security.md with trust model, priority matrix, onboarding checklist

actual_fuzz_executions.reason: Requires C++ libFuzzer harnesses — outside this non-C++ lane. 0 of 44 parsers have active fuzz targets.

fuzz_targets_wired.reason: All 44 parsers are in 'blocked' status pending harness implementation. The CI gate will catch any new parser added without classification.

residual_risks.false_green_risk_1: Source-tree scanner uses regex heuristics — a parser using unconventional patterns (e.g., memory-mapped I/O without fopen/ifstream) could evade detection. Mitigation: manual review of unclassified list.
residual_risks.false_green_risk_2: All 44 parsers are currently blocked — the fuzz gate passes vacuously because no parser claims fuzzed status. The gate only proves classification, not actual coverage. Real fuzz execution is required before SEC-120 can close.
residual_risks.false_green_risk_3: Unclassified sources (119 files) are warnings, not errors, in default mode. CI --ci mode must be enabled to enforce classification completeness.
residual_risks.coverage_gap_1: SparkEditor/Source parsers are scanned but not yet in the KNOWN_PARSERS registry — editor-specific parsers (panel state, project files) need classification.
residual_risks.coverage_gap_2: GameModules/ parsers are not scanned — game module parsers could introduce untrusted-file surfaces.

reason_still_blocking: Zero fuzz targets implemented. This slice delivers the policy infrastructure — the CI gate, inventory, tests, and docs — but no actual fuzzing has occurred. SEC-120 cannot close until at least the highest-priority untrusted-file and untrusted-network parsers have running fuzz harnesses with verified coverage. All 48 parsers are blocked pending C++ harness implementation.
